No. 12 of 2025
AN ACT to amend the Immigration Act, Cap. 10.01.
[ 28th May, 2025 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

194
No. 12 ] Immigration (Amendment) Act [ 2025
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Immigration (Amendment) Act,
2025.
Amendment of section 2
2. Section 2 of the Immigration Act, Cap. 10.01 is amended by
deleting the definition for “Minister” and by substituting the following —
“ “Minister” means the Minister responsible for immigration
matters;”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 10th day of July, 2025.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 15th day of July, 2025.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
